summary: A monolith on Azure App Service using ASP.NET Core with Microsoft SQL Server and a Blazor client. Chosen for an intermediate team of 2 with a $300/month budget and 1,500 users in 12 months.

frontend.justification: Blazor targets web, covering project.platforms=[web]. It reuses the team's skills (team.languages=[csharp, javascript, sql]).

alternatives.why_not: Ranked 0.3 points lower: scored slightly lower overall on the weighted criteria, skill fit and ecosystem coupling.
Ranked 0.5 points lower: weaker on maintainability (rated 4 vs 5, which your priorities weight at 5/5).

tradeoffs: Interactive server mode needs persistent connections
what_would_change: If the target platforms change (today [web]), re-check coverage: HTMX with server-rendered templates is the next option.
If SEO stopped being critical and the app became highly interactive, a SPA framework would become competitive.

backend.justification: The team already knows csharp (team.languages=[csharp, javascript, sql]), which ASP.NET Core uses. A team.experience=intermediate team of team.size=2 gets ASP.NET Core's typed, structured API model (operations burden 2 vs capacity 2). Its mature security and transaction tooling suits compliance=[iso27001] (project.type=internal_tool). It can meet the requirements.p95_latency_ms=800 ms p95 target on Azure App Service. It supports an MVP within timeline.mvp_weeks=6 weeks given its rating of 4/5 for time to market. It integrates natively with the existing Microsoft systems (infrastructure.existing_systems=[Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), On-prem SQL Server 2019]).

alternatives.why_not: Ranked 0.9 points lower: weaker on security (rated 4 vs 5, which your priorities weight at 4/5).
Ranked 1.4 points lower: weaker on maintainability (rated 3 vs 5, which your priorities weight at 5/5).

tradeoffs: Licensing/hosting choices bias toward Microsoft stack
what_would_change: If the team changed languages (today [csharp, javascript]), re-rank: NestJS is the next best fit.
If scale.users_12_months passed 50,000,000, ASP.NET Core would need horizontal scaling and caching (cap = its comfortable range).

database.justification: Microsoft SQL Server suits scale.workload=read_heavy traffic with scale.data_volume_gb_12_months=20 GB after 12 months. It reuses the existing database (infrastructure.existing_systems=[Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), On-prem SQL Server 2019]), avoiding a migration. For infrastructure.data_residency=india: it is self-hosted, so you choose the data location to satisfy data_residency=india. It is acceptable under compliance=[iso27001] as a self-managed store you must harden and audit. Its comfortable range (50,000,000 users) covers scale.users_12_months=1500.

alternatives.why_not: Ranked 0.4 points lower: costs more (about $5-64/mo vs $0-0).
Ranked 1.3 points lower: weaker on maintainability (rated 4 vs 5, which your priorities weight at 5/5); costs more (about $16-74/mo vs $0-0).
Excluded by a hard constraint: belongs to aws but cloud_preference=azure.
Excluded by a hard constraint: belongs to gcp but cloud_preference=azure.

tradeoffs: Licensing cost unless existing licences are reused
what_would_change: If users exceeded 50,000,000, add read replicas or caching, or shard.
If requirements.offline_support became true, a store with device sync (Firestore or CouchDB) would gain priority.

hosting.justification: Azure App Service fits the monthly budget (budget.monthly_infra_usd=300 USD): estimated $13-64/month at scale.users_12_months=1500. It honours the hard constraint infrastructure.cloud_preference=azure. For infrastructure.data_residency=india: it can run in Azure Central India (Pune), India South Central (Hyderabad), South India (Chennai) or West India (Mumbai) to satisfy data_residency=india. It is compatible with compliance=[iso27001] (the knowledge base records vendor attestations for pci_dss, hipaa, soc2, iso27001, gdpr); the legal obligations remain with you. A p95 target of requirements.p95_latency_ms=800 ms is realistic here. Operations burden 1 vs team capacity 2 (team.has_devops=false, team.experience=intermediate).

If the budget rose or operations capacity increased so that Azure Container Apps was affordable and operable, it would be the next choice (it scored 0.5 lower today).

assumptions: Order-of-magnitude band built from each component's fixed + per-1k-user price estimate at scale.users_12_months=1,500; not a quote.
Traffic pattern steady adds no burst allowance.
The upper bound assumes components are not all at their high estimates at once (60% of the summed spread). Excludes taxes, engineers' time, payment-gateway transaction fees and SMS/OTP fees.

compliance_notes: ISO 27001 (iso27001): the cloud providers hold ISO 27001 certifications; certifying your own ISMS is a separate project.

Data residency india: primary data stores and hosting were limited to india-capable options (it can run in Azure Central India (Pune), India South Central (Hyderabad), South India (Chennai) or West India (Mumbai) to satisfy data_residency=india).
integration_notes: Microsoft 365: integrate through Microsoft Graph for mail, calendar and Teams notifications using an Entra app registration.
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): reuse as the identity provider through OpenID Connect so staff sign in with existing accounts; no new user database is needed.

On-prem SQL Server 2019: kept as the system of record; connect from Azure App Service over a private network (VPN/ExpressRoute or hybrid connection) and plan a later move to a managed SQL service. Confirm the server's physical location satisfies data_residency=india.
